name: add
description: Adds a scalar or modulation input to an audio signal

name: adsr
description: Attack-decay-sustain-release envelope generator

name: allpass
description: Allpass filter with configurable delay length and feedback

name: delay_read
description: Reads audio from a named shared delay line with interpolation

name: delay_write
description: Writes audio into a named shared delay line

name: div
description: Divides an audio signal by a scalar or modulation input

name: external
description: Receives audio from an external hardware interface

name: gain
description: Applies multichannel gain with soft clipping (tanh saturation)

name: grain
description: A basic granular synth

name: hadamard
description: Walsh-Hadamard transform mixer for feedback delay networks

name: householder
description: Householder reflection mixer for feedback delay networks

name: mono_fan_out
description: Fans a mono signal out to multiple channels with equal power normalisation

name: mult
description: Multiplies an audio signal by a scalar or modulation input

name: noise
description: A basic noise generator

name: onepole
description: Single-pole lowpass filter (specify `cutoff` in Hz, or the pole coefficient `a` directly)

name: pan
description: A mono to stereo panning node. 0.0 is left, 1.0 is right.

name: plate480
description: Dattorro/Lexicon-480L-style plate reverb (per-sample tank)

name: sampler
description: Plays back a loaded audio sample with variable speed, pitch and region

name: saw
description: Sawtooth wave, PolyBLEP, suitable for synthesis

name: sine
description: Sine wave oscillator with optional FM input

name: sub
description: Subtracts a scalar or modulation input from an audio signal

name: svf
description: State variable filter (lowpass, highpass, bandpass, and more)

name: sweep
description: Frequency sweep oscillator over a configurable range and duration

name: tap
description: Single-tap delay line (no feedback) with cubic interpolation and modulatable delay

name: track_mixer
description: Mixes multiple audio tracks with configurable per-track gain

name: clock
description: Clock signal derived from BPM, beat division, and step count. Accepts a `bpm` message

name: constant
description: Outputs a fixed value, settable at runtime with a `val` message

name: lfo
description: Sine modulation source with a control-kind output

name: map
description: Maps one numeric range to another (e.g. -1..1 → 120..240)

name: phasor
description: Ramp oscillator producing a signal from 0.0 to 1.0

name: sequencer
description: Step sequencer outputting gate, frequency, and velocity per step

name: signal
description: Smoothed control parameter exposed to the host application

name: midi_sequencer
description: Midi step sequencer sending note information to the selected midi channel

name: poly_voice
description: Polyphonic MIDI voice decoder outputting per-voice gate, frequency, and velocity

name: voice
description: Decodes MIDI note events on a channel to gate, frequency, and velocity signals

name: env
description: Edge-triggered ADSR envelope with a control-kind output, for use as a modulation source such as `env >> map >> svf.cutoff`.

name: quantize
description: Snaps a continuous pitch (a MIDI note number) onto the nearest note of a scale, given as `notes: [C, E, G]` or `notes: [0, 4, 7]`. Outputs frequency in Hz on `freq` and the quantized note on `note`.

name: random
description: A modular random source. Each step it takes a new value in `range` with probability `prob`, emitting it on `stepped` (and a one-pole-`smooth`ed copy) while firing `trig`. Free-runs at `rate` ms, or steps on the rising edges of a patched `trig` input.

name: sample_and_hold
description: A basic modular-style sample and hold node, the hold_time parameter determines how frequently it fetches new information.

name: trig_to_gate
description: Holds a gate high for `gate_time` ms on every rising edge of `trig`, so a trigger source such as `quantize.trig` can drive an envelope.
